title: Eisenhower's meeting with ETs about stopping nuclear proliferation

tellings.quote: happened? Well, I got a I got a series of reports from the French Ministry of Defense indicating that meeting did happen, but it wasn't the mythology you're referring to.

related.note: Same alleged Eisenhower meeting with ETs in 1954, but Greer says French documents show it was about stopping nuclear proliferation, not a treaty allowing grey abductions.

plain: A researcher named Steven Greer says on Jesse Michels's podcast that he received a series of reports from the French Ministry of Defense showing that President Dwight Eisenhower really did meet extraterrestrials sometime around 1954 to 1956, with Palm Springs, California named as the place. Greer says the meeting was about stopping the spread of nuclear weapons, not the popular legend of a treaty with grey aliens, and he names Allen Dulles and Paul Melon among those connected to it. If true, it would mean a US president met beings from elsewhere and kept it quiet.
